events.title: Attack UKMTO #165 11 October 2026 UKMTO Suspicious Activity 165-26 UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the vicinity of Sohar anchorage, Oman. The status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Update 001: UKMTO has reclassified this incident as an attack following confirmation that the tanker was struck by an Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV). Local authorities are assisting in the evacuation of the crew, damage assessment and environmental impact is unknown at time of update. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #164 11 October 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident within the Strait of Hormuz. The CSO reported a tanker transiting outbound had been struck on the port side by an unidentified projectile, resulting in damage to the vessel. All crew members were reported safe, and no environmental impact was reported at the time of the attack. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO. Advisory UKMTO #28082035 10 October 2026 UKMTO have received a report of an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman. Vessels are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and maintain awareness of the evolving operational environment. Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.

Attack UKMTO #162 10 October 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident within the Strait of Hormuz. The Master of an outbound tanker reports being struck on the port side by an unknown projectile, causing a fire on board. Crew are reported safe. Damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #160 9 October 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 13NM west of Al Jazeera, UAE. UKMTO has received reports from multiple sources that the vessel has been struck by an unknown projectile causing a fire which has since been extinguished. Status of the crew, damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at present. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

Attack UKMTO #159 6 October 2026 UKMTO has received a time-late report from a verified source, that a crude oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile on the 06 OCT2026, while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #156 5 October 2026 UKMTO_WARNING_156-26 Incident Date: 05 Oct 2026 Incident Time: 1637 UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident within the Strait of Hormuz. Suspicious Activity UKMTO #152 5 October 2026 UKMTO ADVISORY 152-26 SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Incident Date: 05 OCT 2026 Incident Time: 0827UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 11NM north of Khasab, Oman. A tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz inbound was hailed by the IRGC and instructed to turn back or the vessel would be targeted. The Master of the tanker has confirmed that they have complied with the instruction. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
